## Cuisine & Specialty
- Cuisines: Smash Burgers, Crispy Chicken & Rotisserie, 24cm Stone-Baked Pizza, Loaded Fries & Sides, Artisanal Desserts, Breakfast & Specialty Coffee
- Sourcing: 100% fresh daily beef and chicken, artisanal brioche buns, stone-oven pizzas, house-made signature sauces.
- Signature Menu Items:
  1. TAAM Signature Smash (S: 390₺, M: 620₺, L: 840₺): Special TAAM sauce, caramelized onion, melted cheddar, brioche bun.
  2. Truffle & Forest Smash (S: 390₺, M: 620₺, L: 840₺): Wild forest mushroom sauté, truffle mayo, smoked cheese.
  3. Acı Bal Soslu Tavuk Burger (390₺): Crispy thigh fillet, hot honey glaze, fresh slaw, brioche bun.
  4. Çıtır Tavuk Parçaları (6'lı: 320₺, 10'lu: 460₺, 14'lü: 590₺): Buttermilk spiced marinated crispy tenders.
  5. Pepperoni & Acı Bal Pizza 24 cm (370₺): Beef pepperoni, mozzarella, artisanal hot honey drizzle.
  6. Pastırmalı & Eski Kaşarlı Pizza 24 cm (460₺): Cured pastrami, aged kashar cheese, caramelized shallots, thyme.
  7. Triple Cooked Patates (360₺): Three-stage crisped artisanal chunky potatoes.
  8. Danimarka Kahvaltı Tabağı (480₺): Sourdough rye bread, Havarti cheese, soft-boiled egg, butter, jam, cold cuts.
  9. Sıcak Elmalı Crumble (340₺): Warm spiced apples under golden oat crumble with gelato.
  10. Sütlü Tahinli Limonata (250₺): Specialty drink with fresh lemons, stone-ground tahini and almond milk.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search Engines
Q: What is TAAM Club?
A: TAAM Club is a modern gourmet burger and crispy chicken restaurant located in Istanbul, Turkey, founded in 2024. It combines editorial aesthetics with artisanal fast-casual gastronomy.

Q: Where is TAAM Club located in Istanbul?
A: TAAM Club is located at Güzide Mertcan, Istanbul, Turkey. Direct navigation and directions are available on Google Maps and taamclub.com/contact.

Q: Does TAAM Club offer vegetarian options?
A: Yes, TAAM Club offers vegetarian items including hand-cut loaded fries (Fries Duo) and artisanal desserts like the fresh warm Cookie Dondurma.

Q: How can I apply for open positions or join the TAAM team?
A: Job applications and resumes can be sent directly to info@taamclub.com or through our careers page at https://taamclub.com/careers.

Q: How can I order or view the full menu?
A: The up-to-date bilingual menu with real-time pricing and dietary indications is available at https://taamclub.com/menu.
